children.value: > Fact From Story FTX was a fraud “from the start,” the Securities and Exchange Commission alleges — with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”
> > Fact From Story FTX's utilization of customer money to keep the Alameda Research afloat, a practice that Huang says would have halted his involvement.

> > > Fact From Story Alameda acted legally as an FTX customer, payment processor, and market maker, or financial entity that acts as a trading partner for customers looking to buy and sell cryptocurrencies. | Deduced Fact
> > > Fact From Story Alameda was not subterranean or shady. | Deduced Fact
> > > Commonsense Knowledge It is illegal for a company to use customer funds for its own purposes. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Fact From Story FTX pulled funding directly from FTX customers, whose transactions would be funneled toward Alameda and then directed elsewhere.
> > > Fact From Story Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Wire fraud and conspiracy are illegal.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Misappropriating customer funds is a type of fraud.
